summary: Recent updates to the compositing and layers in Firefox focus primarily on enhancing smooth scrolling performance and improving the handling of graphical resources. One significant change is the introduction of **support for binding SurfacePoolCA's surfaces using EGL/ANGLE**, which optimizes how graphics are rendered on Android devices, likely improving visual performance and the responsiveness of web applications. Additionally, tweaks to the way that scroll states are managed, including synchronizing visual and layout scroll offsets, will help ensure that scrolling feels more fluid and accurate for users. This all contributes to a better browsing experience, especially in scenarios involving heavy graphics and animations, as the handling of scroll events and layer management has become more efficient.
